scope: Offline calibration diagnostics of actual saved DALS9 soft moments on all32 cached G1 blocks: fixed variance bins, symbol errors, exact covariance trace and data-noise cross term. No new covariance construction, Cholesky, CE/SVD/F/T/D, exogenous input, parameter tuning, CONF or formal COST. Truth is external only.
grouping_note: A0 success/failure groups are post-hoc descriptive only; no selection or threshold fitting.
